polityNote: Hellenic Republic. 1987–2010 the 13 regions were state planning/administrative groupings of the nomoi (the nomoi remained the self-governing tier); from 2011-01-01 the regions are the first tier. Mount Athos is an autonomous part of Greece outside any region.
